scope: immutable client authenticated-response opening, not replay admission/socket/process CPU/stack/whole memory
mechanism: reuse one transient lazy AES schedule across at most two response candidates; original one-shot open unchanged
oracle: exact original two-search entrypoint plus exact original free authentication helper calling unchanged one-shot AEAD, in same executable
criterion: =0.5.1 default-features=false, temporary hosted dev dependency only

normal.query: round-robin ordinary latest references, absent response PIV

observe.query: last-slot registration plus two distinct downloads; latest/original/intermediate ciphertexts and copied tag tamper; separate key context for each PIV mode

nonce_rule: one encryption per request nonce without PIV; fresh explicit server PIV per encryption; independent normal/PIV/noPIV key contexts; repeated immutable decryption is not fresh encryption

decision.benefit_gate: relative mean <= -0.05 and upper95 < 0 for both benefit metrics in BOTH rounds
decision.guard_gate: upper95 regression <= 0.02 for EVERY guard in BOTH rounds
decision.other: all correctness/source/binary/lock/fixture identity checks PASS; otherwise reject/inconclusive and stop; no replacing any sampled result

ratio_orientation: Criterion second/first minus1; round2 invert ratio and reverse/invert bounds to report candidate/baseline.
runtime: same test executable, host/compiler/flags; pin each measured process to same allowed CPU; no resource scans during timing
setup_policy: retain deterministic setup failures; correct only before ANY timing sample exists. Once any arm samples, no retries/replacements/changed gates.
typing: two exact baseline App empty-slice assertions temporarily annotated as &[u8] without changing assertions, matching validated prior setup
cost_limits: normal still expands once; transient Option/key reference and lifetime may cost branch/layout/code/stack. No persistent memory/cache or public capability changes. Actual emitted stack remains unknown.
